remarks: Be the first to enjoy this beautifully updated sunny, open & spacious ranch in desirable Glenbrook! This home offers an abundance of rooms and opportunity in a popular location offering walking distance to the train, nearby shops & restaurants. Available immediately, this renovated property features a sparkling eat-in kitchen with new cabs, countertops & SS appliances, hardwood flooring, designer living room w/fireplace, primary bedroom w/renovated bath + 3 bedrooms including a large, privately situated bedroom with great space + custom closet. In addition, there is also a den/dining room off the kitchen and an office/flex room off the living room! Two-car attached garage, finished basement with bonus work room, natural gas heat and private back yard complete this move-in ready home with big picture windows and amazing space. Pets OK per owner discretion and may require additional security deposit.
